series.title: Soroban Identity Tutorials
series.description: Build with decentralized identity and verifiable credentials on Stellar. Source code: https://github.com/El-Chapo-Npm/Soroban-Identity

videos.title: Soroban Identity #1 — Introduction
videos.summary: What Soroban Identity is, the problem it solves, and how the three contracts and the SDK fit together.

videos.title: Soroban Identity #2 — Quick Start on Testnet
videos.summary: From a fresh clone to contracts deployed on testnet, the dApp running locally, and your first DID.

videos.title: Soroban Identity #3 — Creating and Managing DIDs
videos.summary: The did:stellar method and DID document, then create, resolve, update and deactivate one with the SDK.

videos.title: Soroban Identity #4 — The Credential Lifecycle
videos.summary: Register an issuer, then issue, look up, verify, renew and revoke a verifiable credential.

videos.title: Soroban Identity #5 — Integration Guide
videos.summary: Build a KYC-gated feature: SDK config, wallet connection, UI gating, server-side enforcement, sybil checks and mainnet.
